# Covista Announces First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Conference Call


September 29, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/400572492/files/doc_news/Covista-Announces-First-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2027-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Covista (the "company" or "Covista") (NYSE: CVSA), America’s largest healthcare educator, announced today it will release its first quarter fiscal year 2027 results on Thursday, October 29, 2026, after market close, followed by a conference call at 4:00 p.m. CT (5:00 p.m. ET) the same day to discuss the results.


This call can be accessed by dialing +1 877-407-6184 (U.S. participants) or +1 201-389-0877 (international participants) and stating “Covista earnings call” or by using conference ID: 13762351. The call will be simulcast through the Covista investor relations website at:[https://investors.covista.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.covista.com&esheet=54610383&newsitemid=20260929412746&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.covista.com&index=1&md5=3af2b18f75f89bd293dbcd00763730b6) . Covista will archive a replay of the call for 30 days. To access the replay, dial +1 877-660-6853 (U.S.) or +1 201-612-7415 (international), conference ID: 13762351, or visit the Covista investor relations website.


**About Covista**


Covista (NYSE: CVSA) is America's largest healthcare educator, serving 100,000 students and supported by a community of 400,000 alumni across five accredited institutions. Through personalized, tech-enabled education powered by 10,000 faculty and colleagues, Covista expands access to healthcare careers and addresses the U.S. healthcare workforce shortage at scale. Covista is the parent company of American University of the Caribbean School of Medicine, Chamberlain University, Ross University School of Medicine, Ross University School of Veterinary Medicine and Walden University. For more information, visit[covista.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.covista.com&esheet=54610383&newsitemid=20260929412746&lan=en-US&anchor=covista.com&index=2&md5=595363078c34b435221587bc12b5b941) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fcovista-official%2F&esheet=54610383&newsitemid=20260929412746&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=3&md5=0e4a7d6d861b266803c9c1290869e149) ,[Instagram](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Flifeatcovista_&esheet=54610383&newsitemid=20260929412746&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram&index=4&md5=11d2f9d223407b938bfd46acf99f51e7) and[YouTube](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40OfficialLifeAtCovista&esheet=54610383&newsitemid=20260929412746&lan=en-US&anchor=YouTube&index=5&md5=202e649aab49d19fe7de8f0febcb1960) .
